ROLLED BACK 2026-07-09 (same day as ship). AE=short was meant to raise dusk sharpness_score above the 11.0 floor. Measurement on saved frames shows it CANNOT: sharpness_score is Laplacian variance, which scales with frame contrast/brightness; AE=short lowers luma by construction (19h matched-hour: luma 68.9->52.0), so it pushes MORE bursts below the floor, not fewer. Run 0006's own pre-registered 'midday regression => reconsider' trigger also fired (16h lap 19.18->15.07). FN unmeasured + plausible FN rise via the below-floor+no-animal mute path => FN-veto => reverted to AE=normal. AE mode is not the lever; the floor statistic is (backlog id 8, now active). AE=normal retained. See runs/0006.
